page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head top centre, page number top right. A bare numeral "XXXII." sits at the lower right, below the text. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: initia noni seculi familiaris Nicephoro Patriarchae: in sermonibus Catecheticis, aliquoties profert loca Epistolae, sub nomine Apostoli.

XXX. Nicephorus, Patriarcha Constantinopolitanus, author τῆς χρονογρα-φίας; idem aliis cum Nicephoro illo Iconolatrâ sede Patriarchali pulso sub Leone Armenio, scriptore ἱστορικῶν συντόμων[?], aliis merito nonnihil junior: in illâ suâ Chronographiâ, à Scaligero insertâ chronico Eusebiano, refert inter scripta N.T. τὰ ἐκκλησιαζόμενα[?], ἢ κεκανονισμένα[?], παύλου ἐπιστολὰς ιδ[?]. Pauli Epistolas quatuordecim.

XXXI. Photius, Patriarcha itidem Constantinop.clarus medio nono seculo, sub Michaële III. & Basilio Imperatoribus, cum Nicolao Papa mutua vibrans anathemata; quid de authore Epistolae ad Hebraeos sentiat, prodit aliquoties in Μυριοβίβλῳ[?]. Imprimis Codice XLVIII. & cxxi, ubi de Caio & Hippolyto Epistolam Paulo negantibus; quod ut novum & à veritate alienum memorat, refertque id inter alia τὰ ἀκριβείας λεγόμενα[?].

page.notes: Greek words marked [?] are read from a small, heavily inked print and are not certain, especially the accents and the abbreviated numeral after παύλου. The Greek title Μυριοβίβλῳ is also uncertain. The page numeral 93 and the running head are clear. Some ink specks and scan noise are not transcribed.
